mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE has exceeded 6.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a drop in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST decline AND RSAFS decline) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, as measured by a negative Rank IC < -0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early recovery phase following a recession, a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals improving manufacturing activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods classified as early recovery with INDPRO rising for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS has been rising for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE rising AND PAYEMS declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, as measured by a negative Rank IC < -0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor conditions, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 6.0% and declining for 3 consecutive months.
